traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Magnoliaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate or palmate; leaves evergreen or deciduous; stipules present; plants usually hermaphrodite, rarely monoecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually tepals, sometimes spiral, rarely sepals and petals; fruit follicle or aggregate, rarely samara; stamens (8-) 50 to 200; carpels (2-) 20 to 200. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.bract_form.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 72, family Magnoliaceae: bract form spathe; one or more circular bracts enclose the flower and are shed at anthesis; read as "spathe".
